review_notes: I read the whole file. It introduces no new definitions, structures or classes. The only new notation is the local `𝓓[K]`, an abbreviation for an expression built from existing HahnSeries and PowerSeries operations. Everything else is a set of lemmas (`jqModC_pow`, `aeval_jqModC_injective`, `qTwist_aeval`, `qExpand_aeval`, `aeval_eq_prod_roots` and similar) and a private closure theorem with a wrapper `solution`. The rubric excludes standalone theorem duplication, so none of these count. The one possible overlap I checked was `algebraMap_eq_C`. It is a lemma, not a competing concept, and it is built from Mathlib's `HahnSeries.algebraMap_apply'` and `ofPowerSeries_C`. `qTwist`, `qExpand`, `jqModC` and `jqNModC` come from imported Definitions files outside the target. I did not review those files. I found no competing version of a Mathlib concept in the target.
